dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: It is well worth exploring this domain thoroughly, though it will take some time. Approximately as long as it would take to read an entire alchemy book from cover to cover, in my estimation.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Perhaps I could assess each threat that awaits us, quantify the total effort required in each case, and... Hmm? From the look on your face... You wish to continue the battle now, correct?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Then let's go. Remember to make each move count, and be ready to change strategy at a moment's notice.
